title: Nice app but no pomodoro function?
body: I wanna love this, but without pomodoro timer it’s not worth using for me. It goes hand in hand with building habits imo.. let me choose my focus time and break time. Otherwise this is just a nice looking todo list with music.
author: saulgman

title: Just awesome
body:
A genuinely awesome and delightful app powered by science. It makes forming habits and sticking to them easy, fun and literally life changing —if the new habit is such! Definitely worth the subscription.
Tip: tap on structures to see what happens.
author: Stefanos Kofopoulos
